title: Winter Wheat, Hard Red, Puffed, Organic

content.title: About
content.content: Organic hard red winter wheat, puffed – whole wheat kernels that have been puffed to create a light, crunchy texture. The grains retain high protein, fiber, and micronutrient levels while offering a convenient snackable form.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Hard red wheat has a higher protein content than soft wheat varieties.
Puffing is achieved by rapid heating, causing steam to expand the kernel interior.
Organic farming prohibits synthetic pesticides and fertilizers, preserving soil biodiversity.
Winter wheat is planted in the fall and harvested in summer, allowing a deep root system to develop over winter.
Puffed wheat is often used in children's cereals because of its easy digestibility.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Hard red wheat provides about 13‑15 % protein, supporting muscle maintenance and tissue repair.

items.title: High in dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion, satiety, and stable blood sugar levels.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: B1, B3, and B6 are important for energy metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Minerals: iron and magnesium
items.content: Iron aids oxygen transport, while magnesium supports muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Lower glycemic impact after puffing
items.content: Puffed grains raise blood glucose more slowly than unprocessed wheat, beneficial for blood sugar control.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: Some individuals may react to wheat proteins or gluten.

items.title: Gluten content
items.content: Not suitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Although puffed, the product still contains calories; portion control is advised for weight management.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy puffed wheat as a snack, add it to granola, yogurt, salads, soups, or incorporate it into baked goods for extra crunch.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place. For long‑term storage, refrigerate to prevent fat oxidation.
